title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E01 — And the Crown of King Arthur
Someone is killing off potential Librarians, and it's up to Flynn Carsen and his new Guardian, Colonel Eve Baird, to save the three that are left.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E02 — And the Sword in the Stone
The Serpent Brotherhood is trying to return magic to the world; Flynn, Colonel Baird, and the potential Librarians must stop them before it's too late.

S02 E01 — Redemption: The Debutante Job
The team pulls Harry back into the fold to help a journalist investigating corruption.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E02 — The One Man's Trash Job
The crew finds out that a shady plastics exporter whose dumping threatens local waters is smuggling black market antiquities on his barges, and plots to relieve him of his ill-gotten gains.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E03 — And the Ghost Train
Half of the Librarian team gets trapped on a runaway ghost train; can the rest of the team help in solving the unresolved business of the ghosts on board before the train completes a rampage of destruction?

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E04 — And the Thief of Love
The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake; when they learn that a magical love artifact is behind the thefts, they enlist help from Vikram's old friend, Cupid himself.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E05 — Unbecalming
When a typhoon hits the island, criminals and their hostages become trapped inside the police station; Alex must find a way to save his friends as well as a sworn enemy.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E06 — Rise of the Kalangay
Alex, feeling competitive, races to solve a murder before a celebrated detective can find the killer; things take a turn when Alex realizes the crime leads back to the murder of Kai's mother 15 years earlier.

description:

Alex's con-artist uncle comes for a visit to make amends and Alex finds himself caught between protecting the world from his uncle and protecting his uncle from Kai and Ernesto, as well as a mafia enforcer.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S01 E08 — Lone Wolf
When Alex takes a job protecting a country singer he idolizes, he quickly learns that one should never meet one's heroes; when the singer is kidnapped, Alex must figure out who is really behind the crime and rescue him before it's too late.

title: Emerson Heights
description: When Los Angeles actor Cody McClain falls for New Yorker Briley Williams, they attempt to beat the odds of long-distance love. But when Cody lands the lead role in a blockbuster film, they realize that distance may not be their biggest hurdle.
